heading: Projects
subtitle: A selection of projects I've built and contributed to.

items.title: Telegram GPT
items.description: A LangGraph-powered Telegram agent that lives in group chats as an assistant — with tool use, persistent memory, and multi-step reasoning.

items.title: VibePlan
items.description: An AI-powered itinerary planner for Singapore that scrapes live social media data to recommend activities based on vibe, budget, and real-time trends.

items.title: MoneyGo
items.description: A cross-platform personal finance mobile app featuring AI receipt scanning, expense tracking, and data visualization.

items.title: NotiflyMeBot
items.description: A Telegram reminder bot that uses Gemini AI & Duckling to parse natural language dates (e.g., 'tomorrow at 3pm') and schedules automated alerts.

items.title: NUS GPA Calculator
items.description: A rich academic tracking tool for NUS students to compute CAP/GPA, featuring CSV import/export, semester filtering, and local storage persistence.

items.title: Tze Foong's Timer
items.description: A URL-based timer and stopwatch application allowing instant configuration via URL paths with a clean, responsive Tailwind UI.

items.title: Heartfelt Support Bot
items.description: An anonymous Telegram bot connecting users with support members while maintaining complete privacy for both parties via masked identities.

items.title: Raffles Hall Confessions Bot
items.description: A Telegram bot facilitating anonymous confessions posted to a channel with public comment threads, managing user anonymity.
